item.title: Dining in the District
item.description:
Thursday, August 6, 2026 at 6 PM

Location: Oreatha’s At The Point, 2287 Cascade Rd, Atlanta, GA, 30311, United States

« All Events BBQ & Brews August 8 @ 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM BBQ, Brews & School Pride!Rep your school, enjoy delicious BBQ, grab Stella swag, and enter to win MEAC/SWAC Challenge tickets! Join us for an unforgettable BBQ & Brews celebration during Black Restaurant Week, in partnership with ATL Airport District and Stella Artois! Enjoy mouthwatering BBQ, ice-cold Stella Artois, great vibes, and fellowship with the community. Stop by the Stella Artois Airstream for complimentary swag and beer (21+), and don’t miss your chance to win exciting prizes—including a giveaway from ATL Airport District for tickets to the Cricket MEAC/SWAC Challenge Kick-Off Presented by Toyota!
